title: aconitum lycoctonum subsp. vulparia
intro: Aconitum lycoctonum subsp. vulparia, commonly known as wolf's bane, is a subspecies of the Aconitum lycoctonum plant, belonging to the Aconitum genus and the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Aconitum lycoctonum subsp. vulparia include its ability to act as a cardiac stimulant, increase blood pressure, and exhibit sedative and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids such as aconitine, mesaconitine, and hypaconitine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
